classification.difficultyReason: Translate the marked angles into a straight-line or quadrilateral sum, solve the resulting equation, then interpret a right angle, angle ratio or supplementary co-interior pair to establish the stated conclusion.

spec.description: Straight PBQ divided by ray BA into two alpha angles.
spec.answerVisibility: No right-angle mark or answer supplied.

answer.short:
$AB\perp PQ$.

The two equal adjacent angles on $PQ$ are each $90^\circ$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2\alpha&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=90^\circ\end{align*}$$
Adjacent angles on straight line $PQ$ are supplementary. Thus $\angle ABQ=90^\circ$, so $AB\perp PQ$.

spec.description: Vertical PBQ with ray BA descending right.
spec.mathematics: Angle PBA=alpha+30 degrees; angle ABQ=alpha-30 degrees.

answer.worked:
Adjacent angles on straight line $PQ$ are supplementary.
$$\begin{align*}(\alpha+30^\circ)+(\alpha-30^\circ)&=180^\circ\\2\alpha&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=90^\circ\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\angle ABP&=90^\circ+30^\circ=120^\circ\\\angle ABQ&=90^\circ-30^\circ=60^\circ\end{align*}$$
Hence $\angle ABP=2\times\angle ABQ$.

spec.description: Straight BOA with upper rays OP, OC and OQ.
spec.mathematics: Consecutive angles from OB to OA are beta,beta,alpha,alpha.
spec.answerVisibility: No right-angle mark or answer supplied.

answer.worked:
Angles on straight line $BA$ sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}2\alpha+2\beta&=180^\circ\\\alpha+\beta&=90^\circ\\\angle POQ&=\beta+\alpha=90^\circ\end{align*}$$
Therefore $PO\perp QO$.

spec.description: Quadrilateral ABCD with four algebraic interior angle labels.
spec.answerVisibility: No parallel marks or answer supplied.

answer.short:
$AB\parallel DC$.

$\alpha=36^\circ$, so the co-interior angles at $A$ and $D$ sum to $180^\circ$.
answer.worked:
The interior angles of quadrilateral $ABCD$ sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}3\alpha+\alpha+4\alpha+2\alpha&=360^\circ\\10\alpha&=360^\circ\\\alpha&=36^\circ\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\angle DAB+\angle ADC&=3\alpha+2\alpha\\\angle DAB+\angle ADC&=5\times36^\circ\\\angle DAB+\angle ADC&=180^\circ\end{align*}$$
Therefore $AB\parallel DC$, since these co-interior angles are supplementary.
